methods.label: Find and compare all three angles
methods.explanation:
The largest angle need not be one of the specified two, so find all three. A right angle measures \(90^\circ\), making the given pair's sum
\[
\frac65\cdot90^\circ=108^\circ.
\]
Subtracting the extra \(30^\circ\) from the larger of these two leaves two equal copies of the smaller angle. Thus the smaller angle is \((108^\circ-30^\circ)/2=39^\circ\), and the larger is \(39^\circ+30^\circ=69^\circ\). The triangle's third angle is
\[
180^\circ-108^\circ=72^\circ.
\]
Since \(72>69>39\), the largest angle is \(72^\circ\), choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
